title: Terms & Conditions
introText: Welcome to Hijabs By Shiza (HBS), Pakistan's premier modest fashion brand and the first in the country to introduce genuine crinkle silk hijabs and niqabs. By accessing and using our website, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before using our services.
acceptanceText: By using our website and services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions.

sections.heading: 1. General Terms
sections.content:
By using this website, you confirm that you accept these terms and conditions and agree to comply with them. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use our website.

We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Your continued use of the website following any changes constitutes acceptance of those changes.

sections.content:

Prices are subject to change without notice. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue products at any time without liability.

sections.heading: The Color Disclaimer
sections.content:
We try our best to display the colours or images of the products as accurately as possible, but cannot guarantee that what you see is an exact representation.

We do not assure an exact coloration match because of lighting effects and various platforms on which you see our products like laptops, mobiles, desktops and tablets.

Note: Just because products have the same color name that does not mean they are the same exact color. Also, don't mistake the color name to be what you may think that color should be. Example, just because a color may have the name Teal, it does not mean it will necessarily look like what most people would consider being a Teal color.

sections.heading: 3. Orders and Payment
sections.content:
When you place an order, you are making an offer to purchase products. We reserve the right to accept or decline your order for any reason.

Payment must be made in full before order processing. We accept bank transfers to our designated account. After making the payment, you are required to upload the payment receipt on our website during checkout.

All payment receipts will be manually verified within 2-4 hours. Your order will be processed only after successful verification of the payment receipt.

By providing payment information and uploading a receipt, you confirm that you have made the payment and that the receipt provided is genuine and accurate.

sections.heading: 4. Shipping and Delivery
sections.content:
We deliver across Pakistan and ship worldwide. Cash on Delivery (COD) is available specifically in Karachi. Delivery times vary based on your location and selected shipping method. We are not responsible for delays caused by customs or courier services.

Orders can be placed through our website, via WhatsApp at +92 346 0336634, or through direct messages on our social media platforms. It is your responsibility to provide accurate shipping information. We are not liable for delays or non-delivery resulting from incorrect addresses.

sections.heading: 5. Exchange Policy
sections.content:
At Hijabs By Shiza, we do not offer returns. However, we do have an exchange policy under specific conditions:

1. Wrong Color Sent
If you receive a completely different color from what you ordered (not a slight variation due to screen differences), we will exchange it at no cost to you.

2. Color Variations
Please note that slight color differences may occur due to screen resolution and lighting. Our catalog clearly mentions that the color you select may not be 100% identical in reality. Therefore, exchanges will not be accepted for minor color variations.

Although we try our best to capture colors as close as possible to how they appear in real life, we cannot guarantee a hundred percent match. The difference between different display screens is minimal but beyond our control; hence refunds/exchanges cannot be provided on this basis.

3. Personal Preference
If you receive the exact shade you ordered but wish to exchange it for another color, you may do so. However, in this case:

You must cover the delivery charges (DC) for returning the item.
We do not arrange pickups; you must send the product via a courier service of your choice.
When we send the exchanged item back to you, the delivery charges will be your responsibility.

4. Product Quality Assurance
We thoroughly inspect all products before dispatch to ensure there are no defects or damages. Therefore, exchanges for damaged items are not applicable.

5. No Returns or Exchanges for Company Mistakes
Please note that we do not offer returns or exchanges, even in cases where we may have made an error. This policy applies regardless of the nature of the mistake on our part.

Important: We appreciate your understanding and encourage you to check color variations on our website before placing an order.

Policy Notice: No return and no exchange in case of our mistake. This policy is final and applies to all orders.
